He also represents the [[Croatia men's national basketball team|Croatian national basketball team]]. ==Professional career== ===Early years=== After joining [[KK Zagreb|Zagreb]], he won the Città di Roma [[Euroleague Basketball Nike International Junior Tournament|NIJT]] in 2011, alongside teammates, [[Mario Hezonja]] and [[Dominik Mavra]], and progressed to the Final Four of the tournament, which his team eventually won.{{cite news |url=http://www.eurohopes.com/news/1344/nijt-barcelona-day-3-final-kk-zagreb-the-champion-saric-the-mvp/|title= NIJT Barcelona (day 3 & final): KK Zagreb, the champion; Saric, the MVP|publisher=eurohopes.com|date=08/05/2011|accessdate=08/06/2013}} After he had registered a [[triple-double]] in the final game with 19 points, 14 rebounds and 10 assists, in addition to 10 drawn fouls, he was named the MVP of the tournament.{{cite news |url=http://www.vecernji.hr/sport/kosarka/juniori-zagreba-osvojili-kosarkasku-euroligu-clanak-285136|title=Juniori Zagreba osvojili košarkašku Euroligu!|publisher=[[Večernji list]]|first=Dražen|last=Brajdić|language=Croatian|date=08/05/2011|accessdate=08/06/2013}}{{cite news |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=75979|title=Dario Saric, la gran esperanza croata|publisher=[[Liga ACB|ACB]]|first=Pablo|last=Malo de Molina|language=Spanish|accessdate=09/06/2013}} In 2010 and 2011, Šarić was nominated for the [[FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award]].{{cite news |url=http://sportski.net.hr/kosarka/mladi-hrvat-cetvrti-najbolji-igrac-europe|title=Mladi Hrvat četvrti najbolji igrač Europe!|publisher=Sportski.net|language=Croatian|date=2012-02-13|accessdate=03/07/2013}} In 2012, he was selected to play for the World Team, for the second year in a row, at the [[Nike Hoop Summit]] in [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], Oregon.{{cite news |url=http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/news/lateNews/arti.asp?newsid=50992|title=USA - Saric headlines World Team for Hoop Summit|publisher=[[FIBA]]|date=2012-03-27|accessdate=08/06/2013}} In the all-star game, the international players of the world team beat the US team, with Šarić scoring 13 points and leading in rebounds (14) and assists (5).{{cite news |url=http://www.sbnation.com/nba/2012/4/8/2933480/nike-hoop-summit-2012-final-score-recap-shabazz-muhammed-andrew-wiggins/in/2696265|title=Nike Hoop Summit 2012 Recap: World Select Tops Team USA, 84-75|publisher=sbnation.com|first=Ben|last=Golliver|date=08/04/2012|accessdate=08/06/2013}}{{cite news |url=http://www.nacional.hr/clanak/128030/mladi-dario-saric-u-pobjednickoj-selekciji-svijeta|title=Mladi Dario Šarić u pobjedničkoj selekciji Svijeta|publisher=[[Nacional (weekly)|Nacional]]|language=Croatian|date=10/04/2012|accessdate=09/06/2013}} He signed with [[Bilbao Basket]] and was loaned to [[KK Split|Split]] in 2012. However, due to a sanction by [[FIBA]], forcing the Spanish team to pay a buyout of €550,000, he didn't sign with Bilbao.{{cite news |url=http://www.acb.com/redaccion.php?id=88978|title=Dario Saric no jugará en el Gescrap Bizkaia|publisher=ACB.com|language=Spanish|date=08/11/2012|accessdate=09/06/2013}} After that, he trained with Split, but was not playing games with them. ===Cibona Zagreb=== In November 2012, he signed a four-year contract with the Croatian club [[KK Cibona|Cibona]].{{cite news |url=http://www.abaliga.com/a5624/News/Cibona_inks_Dario_Saric.html|title=Cibona inks Dario Šarić|publisher=[[ABA League]]|date=2012-11-28|accessdate=08/06/2013}} Again, in 2012, he was nominated for the FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award, finishing second.{{cite news |url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/coid_MUMtgYLNGw6ts8a4RCdLp3.articleMode_on.html|title=Valanciunas Young Men’s POY 2012|publisher=FIBAEurope.com|date=06/02/2013|accessdate=2013-02-20}} Šarić had initially decided to declare for the [[2013 NBA Draft]] on April 4, 2013.{{cite news |url=http://www.sbnation.com/nba/2013/4/4/4183418/dario-saric-2013-nba-draft|title=Dario Saric to declare for the 2013 NBA Draft, according to report|first=Jonathan|last=Tjarks|publisher=[[SB Nation]]|date=2013-04-04|accessdate=09/06/2013}} However, two days after the initial declaration, he decided not to participate in it and had planned to play for KK Cibona for at least one more season.{{cite news |url=http://www.sbnation.com/nba/2013/4/6/4190304/dario-saric-nba-draft-2013-croatia|title=Dario Saric will not enter 2013 NBA draft|first=Ethan|last=Rothstein|publisher=SB Nation|date=06/04/2013|accessdate=09/06/2013}} Šarić would, however, officially declare himself for the draft once again on April 14, 2013.{{cite news |url=http://sports.yahoo.com/news/nba--croatian-teen-dario-saric-declares-for-nba-draft-195321165.html|title=Croatian teen Dario Saric declares for NBA draft|publisher=[[Yahoo! Sports]]|first=Adrian|last=Wojnarowski|date=2013-04-14|accessdate=09/06/2013}} Finally, Šarić withdrew from the draft altogether, because of his desire to stay in Europe for another year, to gain experience.{{cite news |url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2013/story/_/id/9393543/2013-nba-draft-agent-says-dario-saric-withdraw-draft|title=Agent: Dario Saric to exit draft|publisher=ESPN|first=Chad|last=Ford|date= June 16, 2013|accessdate=2013-06-17}}{{cite news |url=http://nba.si.com/2013/06/08/dario-saric-leaning-toward-staying-in-europe-forego-nba-draft/|title=Dario Saric leaning toward staying in Europe, forego NBA draft|work=Sports Illustrated|first=Chris|last=Mannix|date=09/06/2013|accessdate=09/06/2013}} In 2013, he won the [[Krešimir Ćosić Cup|Croatian National Cup]] and [[A-1 Liga|Croatian Championship]] with Cibona, and won the MVP award for the Croatian finals.{{cite news |url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2013/story/_/id/9349336/2013-nba-draft-dario-saric-leaning-exiting|title=Dario Saric may stay in Croatia|publisher=ESPN|first=Chad|last=Ford|date=2013-06-06|accessdate=08/06/2013}} He was named the [[FIBA Europe Young Men's Player of the Year Award|2013 FIBA Europe Young Player of the Year]] in February 2014.{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/coid_,qIYgqUhJ-Ue6pPZvVE7q1.articleMode_on.html|title=Saric is 2013 Young Men's POY|date=5 February 2014|accessdate=7 February 2014|publisher=FIBAEurope.com}} In April 2014, he was selected into the ideal team and also named the MVP of the [[Adriatic League]], averaging 16.7 points, 9.7 rebounds and 3.2 assists in the [[2013–14 ABA League|regular season]].{{cite web|title=The ideal five of the 2013/14 season selected|url=http://www.abaliga.com/a7487/News/The_ideal_five_of_the_2013/14_season_selected.html|publisher=abaliga.com|accessdate=21 April 2014|date=21 April 2014}}{{cite web|title=Dario Saric Scouting Report and Video Breakdown|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Dario-Saric-5706/|publisher=draftexpress.com|accessdate=May 10, 2014|first=Jonathan|last=Givony|date=May 9, 2014}}{{cite web|title=Agent: Croatia’s Dario Saric declares for 2014 NBA draft|url=http://nba.si.com/2014/04/27/dario-saric-declares-nba-draft-2014-croatia/|publisher=nba.si.com|accessdate=2014-04-28|first=Ben|last=Golliver|date=April 27, 2014}} In the Final Four of the competition, Cibona eventually won the league championship and Šarić was proclaimed the MVP of the finals.{{cite news |url=http://www.jutarnji.hr/cedevita---cibona-tko-ce-u-zagreb-donijeti-najveci-kosarkaski-trofej-u-posljednjih-27-godina-/1186875/|title=Briljantni Šarić srušio Cedevitu i odveo Cibonu do prvog trofeja u regionalnoj ligi!|work=[[Jutarnji list]]|first=Tvrtko|last=Puljić|language=Croatian|date=27 April 2014|accessdate=2014-04-27}} ===Anadolu Efes=== On June 24, 2014, he signed a 2+1 contract with the Turkish team [[Anadolu Efes S.K.|Anadolu Efes]].{{cite web|title=Anadolu Efes Dario Saric’i kadrosuna kattı...|url=https://www.anadoluefessporkulubu.org/haber/anadolu-efes-dario-sarici-kadrosuna-katti|website=anadoluefessporkulubu.org|accessdate=24 June 2014|language=Turkish}}{{cite news|title=Dario Saric officially signs with Anadolu Efes Istanbul|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/turkey/124012/dario-saric-officially-signs-with-anadolu-efes-istanbul.html|accessdate=June 24, 2014|work=Sportando.com|date=June 24, 2014}} Cibona also received US$1.2 million in the name of buyout from Anadou Efes, as Šarić was still under contract with Cibona. He signed the offer days before the [[2014 NBA draft]] commenced.{{cite web|last1=McIntyre|first1=Jason|title=Dario Saric Signs 3-Year Deal with Turkey Basketball Team; Loaded NBA Draft Gets Thinner|url=http://thebiglead.com/2014/06/23/dario-saric-signs-3-year-deal-with-turkey-basketball-team-loaded-nba-draft-gets-thinner/|website=thebiglead.com|accessdate=24 June 2014}}{{cite web|last1=Ford|first1=Chad|title=Dario Saric to stay in Europe|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2014/story/_/id/11122639/nba-prospect-dario-saric-agrees-principle-three-year-deal-turkish-team|website=espn.go.com|accessdate=24 June 2014}} ==Croatian national team== Šarić was named Most Valuable Player of the [[2010 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]] in a unanimous vote, after leading the tournament in scoring (24.3 ppg) and rebounding (11.5 rpg), and finishing second in assists (5.8 apg). He registered a [[triple-double]] (30 points, 11 rebounds, 11 assists) in the final, becoming only the second player to do so (after [[Ricky Rubio]] in 2006).{{Cite web|url=http://u16men.fibaeurope.com/en/cid_z8jOMILgHCsbXTL1wG4sq0.teamID_96781.compID_YUjW-7-FJ,kK9s431Lyr41.season_2011.roundID_8168.coid_Mi,5gQAuJ,2JOPCt0gRGr3.articleMode_on.html|title=Saric Heads All-Tournament Team|date=16 August 2010|accessdate=09/06/2013|first=Yarone|last=Arbel|publisher=FIBAEurope.com}} Šarić also played in the [[2011 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]], where he finished fourth in scoring (18.1 ppg) and third in rebounds (10.1 rpg), despite being one of the youngest participants at 17 years of age. He won a gold medal with Croatia in the [[2012 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], where he finished first in scoring (25.6 ppg) and second in rebounds (10.1 rpg).{{cite news |url=http://www.tubasket.com/noticia/bizkaia-bilbao-basket/dario-saric-arrasa-final-eurobasket-sub18-39-puntos-11-rebotes-titulo-croacia-video/2323732/6293|title=Dario Saric arrasa en la final del Eurobasket Sub-18|publisher=Tubasket.com|first=Marc|last=Amposta|language=Spanish|date=2012-08-20|accessdate=09/06/2013}} Soon after scoring 39 points to lead Croatia to victory in the gold medal game against Lithuania, Šarić was voted unanimously as tournament MVP.{{cite news |url=http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/coid_dFf-TMn3IO6YwpyLlpUQq2.articleMode_on.html|title=MVP Saric Heads All Tournament
